tips: Start applying for internships from 2nd year onwards.
Build a GitHub profile before applying — companies will check it.
Complete at least one free NPTEL or Coursera certificate to strengthen your profile.
Use LinkedIn to connect with alumni from your college working at target companies.
Tailor your resume for each application — highlight relevant projects and skills.
Virtual internships (Forage, Remote OK) count as experience and are beginner-friendly.
Follow company career pages directly — many listings appear there first.
